messages:
anna: heads-up — after the q4 quantization pass for `model-x-1b` embeddings, our reranker eval NDCG dropped by ~3.7% vs float32 baseline on the internal benchmark. repro script + logs attached.

miguel: ouch. which conversion path did you use? hf->rw converter or the hand-rolled loader?

anna: used the hf2rw converter (rw-convert v0.9). command: `rw-convert --model hf/model-x-1b --to redwood --quant 8bit` . eval-run: `./eval/rerank_eval.sh --model converted/model-x-1b-q8`

eval-bot: perf-summary: baseline float32 NDCG@10=0.421; q8 converted NDCG@10=0.405; delta=-0.016 (~3.80%). embedding cosine mean drop: 0.012.

sam: quick checklist: tokenizer special tokens, tokenizer.add_prefix_space, chat template insertion, pooling index (cls vs last), and truncation side. Small changes there often shift embedding alignment.

kevin: can you paste the tokenizer config.json from the converted model? I suspect cls_token_id mismatch or extra BOS token from chat template.

anna: pasted below. note: hf tokenizer had both "bos_token": "<s>" and "cls_token": "<s>". converter left cls_token_id as 0.

```
{
  "bos_token": "<s>",
  "eos_token": "</s>",
  "unk_token": "<unk>",
  "pad_token": "<pad>",
  "cls_token": "<s>",
  "sep_token": "</s>",
  "special_tokens_map": {"cls_token": "<s>"},
  "add_prefix_space": false
}
```

miguel: that double-usage is suspicious. HF and some chat templates sometimes treat `<s>` as BOS only, while our embedding pooling expects a distinct CLS token at index 0. If the converter doesn't remap, CLS pooling ends up using a token that's actually a BOS inserted elsewhere.

sam: also check truncation behavior — HF default can be `longest_first` with `truncation_side: "right"`, but our eval harness pads/truncates differently (we default to `only_first` and left-pad for rerank job). That changes which token becomes CLS-position after truncation when chat system messages are present.

anna: repro: tokenized lengths for this example: HF tokenization => [<s>, user tokens..., </s>] => token ids: [0, 12, 345, 78, 2]. Converted tokenizer yields same ids but the converter also prepended an extra system prompt from chat-template, so actual input to model was: [0, 101, ... user tokens..., 2] and we were pooling index 0 as CLS. For some queries truncation dropped tail tokens causing the semantic anchor to shift.

kevin: can you show the rw-serving pooling config? we support explicit pooling map now — if it's still set to "cls" but cls_token_id points to an inserted BOS, that's the bug.

anna: config excerpt from converted model metadata:

```
"pooling": "cls",
"cls_token_id": 0,
"truncation": {"strategy": "right", "max_length": 512}
```

miguel: fix options:
- remap cls_token to a dedicated id (prefer separate `<cls>` token) and update pooling
- or switch pooling to use `pooling: last` with `pool_position: sentence_end` for embedding-only models
- align truncation strategy with the HF eval harness (use `only_first` and explicit chat-template tokens)

sam: for quick triage, try rerunning conversion with `--preserve-specials` and `--no-chat-template` flags, and set `--truncation only_first`. Also run a float32 convert (without quant) to confirm this is conversion/templating rather than quant noise.

anna: re-ran with `rw-convert --model hf/model-x-1b --to redwood --preserve-specials --no-chat-template --truncation only_first` and float32. New float32 converted NDCG@10=0.420 (matches baseline). Then q8 with same flags => NDCG@10=0.419 (delta -0.002). Looks like the big drop was the template + cls mismap, quant added a small extra ~0.1-0.2%.

eval-bot: updated perf-summary: converted (float32, no-template) NDCG@10=0.420; converted q8 (no-template) NDCG@10=0.419.

infra-bot: FYI deploy logs: previous automated conversion pipeline included `--chat-template auto` by default for chat models; changed to `opt-in` in the pipeline today at 09:12 UTC. Rollback available.

kevin: great find. action items: (1) update converter to warn when cls_token == bos_token and pooling==cls, (2) add test that runs a few anchor queries through conversion to catch token shifts, (3) change pipeline default to not auto-insert chat-templates for embed-only conversions.

anna: filing an onboarding ticket with repro steps + minimal example. TY all.
